theme: Three days of honest self-examination — seeing yourself more clearly

days.task: Ask one trusted person: 'What's one blind spot I might have about myself?' Just listen. Don't defend. Write what you heard.
Notice one emotional trigger today — something that made you reactive. Write: what set it off, what it might reveal.
Write an honest self-assessment: 3 genuine strengths, 2 real growth edges, 1 pattern you're ready to change.
